comment: Fe-S-dependent methyltransferase of the KGR pathway. Methylates the side-chain amine of ornithine-41 (made from Arg41 by KgrD) in thiomorpholine-containing KgrA, with SAM as methyl donor; not radical SAM reaction.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 fixed reaction SMARTS to show full precursor peptide.

reactions.description: N-methylation of the side-chain amine of ornithine-41 in thiomorpholine-containing KgrA
N-methylornithine- and thiomorpholine-containing KgrA; cleaved to enteropeptin A by KgrE or other proteases
